author: cellish
body:
Hi there!

Yesterday I spent some time making a skywars map called "Fossil" 
Hope you like it!

Teams: 2 player teams (8 islands) 16 Players
Download: Not yet
Teams: Red - Blue - Green - Yellow - Orange - Lime - Black - White (Spectators - Cyan)
Pics: http://imgur.com/a/DKkqT
XML/YML idk: NEED HELP

Well, That was my map, thanks for reading and please give feedback!!

If you want to see the map clearly or better join: [Redacted]
And to come to the map you type: /mvtp Sam5
And it is probably going to say that you have to do /mvconfirm to come to the Island, then do /mvconfirm to get teleported!! 

DONT GREIF!!
